```{r}
plot_shift_with_hist <- function(coef_data, variables, type, matched){
  
  
  plot_data <- coef_data %>% 
  filter(variable %in% variables) %>% 
  filter(cum_energy_test >= 5000)


  
  my_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data) +
    # Courbe principale avec bande de confiance
    geom_line(aes(x = cum_energy_test, y = estimate, color = variable)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        x = cum_energy_test, 
        ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std_error, 
        ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std_error,
        fill = variable
      ), 
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60000)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Shift in Demand Curve by additional unit"),
      x = "Cumulative Energy (MWh)",
      y = "Price (€)",
      color = "Variable",
      fill = "Variable"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  if (matched == "matched"){
    # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
    scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge_esp$load_tot, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
    my_plot <- my_plot + 
    # Histogramme mis à l'échelle
    geom_histogram(
      data = price_indispo_merge_esp,
      mapping = aes(x = load_tot, y = ..count.. * scale_factor),
      bins = 60,
      color = "black",
      fill = NA
    )+
    # Axe secondaire
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Price (€)",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Fréquence de gen_tot")
    )
  }
  
  # if (type == "Supply") {
  #   my_plot <- my_plot + 
  #     coord_flip()
  # }
  
  return(my_plot)
}
```

```{r}

plot_shift_with_hist_qty <- function(coef_data, variables, type, matched){
  

  plot_data <- coef_data %>% 
    filter(variable %in% variables) 
  # %>% 
  #   filter(price_test >= -100)
  
  # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
  scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge_esp$load_tot, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
  my_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data) +
    # Courbe principale avec bande de confiance
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate, color = variable)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate, color = variable)) +
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = 0), linetype = "dashed")+
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        x = price_test, 
        ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std_error, 
        ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std_error,
        fill = variable
      ), 
      alpha = 0.2
    ) + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Shift in ", type, " Curve"),
      x = "Price (€)",
      y = "Cumulative Energy (MWh)",
      color = "Variable",
      fill = "Variable"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  if (matched == "matched"){
    # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
    scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge_esp$price, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
    my_plot <- my_plot + 
    # Histogramme mis à l'échelle
    geom_histogram(
      data = price_indispo_merge_esp,
      mapping = aes( x = price,  y = ..count.. * scale_factor),
      bins = 60,
      color = "black",
      fill = NA
    )
    
    # Axe secondaire
    # scale_y_continuous(
    #   name = "Price (€/GWh)",
    #   sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Fréquence de gen_tot")
    # )
  }
  my_plot <- my_plot +
  coord_flip(xlim = c(-20, 300))

  return(my_plot)
}

```
